typography.strategy: Soft Utility (Friendly but professional). Tight tracking on role names, legible mono or clean sans for data like dates and counts. Avoid Inter for headings.

layouts.page: Dashboard with dark sidebar. Main content area padding should be generous (p-8 or p-12).
layouts.table: Dense, cardless list. Use standard table or CSS Grid with border-collapse. Row borders should be subtle (border-border/40). No heavy shadows on the table container, just a 1px border. Use the 'Grid Borders (The Technical Look)' surface strategy.

components.Table: Shadcn Table with custom styling. Remove outer card, keep it flat. Sticky header for better scrolling context.

RoleRow.Column1_RoleInfo: Role Name (font-medium text-lg). Below it, display the 'role_master_name' as a subtle template badge. If `is_system_role` is true, add a 'System Protected' mini-badge with a lock icon.
RoleRow.Column2_Users: A clean pill or text showing 'X Employees'. Use a small Users icon next to the number. Make it look clickable (as it conceptually filters the employees tab).
RoleRow.Column3_Permissions: Visual Permission Distribution. Show 'X/52 Modules' text prominently. Below it, include a 'PermissionCoverageBar' component: a mini segmented progress bar or a flex row of colored dots representing the 8 business categories (Orders, Discounts, etc.). Use green for high coverage, orange for partial, gray for none. Tooltip on hover showing exact category breakdown.
RoleRow.Column4_LastModified: text-sm text-muted-foreground showing the date, e.g., 'Oct 24, 2023'.
RoleRow.Column5_Status: Shadcn Switch component. Green when active (status=1), gray when inactive (status=0). Disable switch if `is_system_role`.
RoleRow.Column6_Actions: Ghost button for Edit. If `is_editable` is false, use a View (eye) icon instead of Edit and apply a disabled or read-only styling.

components.PageHeader: Title 'Roles' (text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight). Right side: Search Input (Shadcn) + Filter Dropdown (Role Type) + 'Create Role' primary button in brand green.

visual_enhancers.badges: Use subtle colored backgrounds for badges (e.g., bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 for 'Template: Manager'). System Protected badge in slate/gray with a lock icon.
visual_enhancers.permission_bar: A 100% width, h-2 flex container. Split into segments based on access categories to visually demonstrate what the role can do without reading a list.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react for rich iconography (lock, users, shield, pencil, eye).

motion.hover: Table rows should have a subtle bg-muted/50 hover state. Do not use scale transitions on rows.
motion.interactions: Switch toggling should be smooth. Button hover states must explicitly declare text color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure green text/badges meet minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.data-testid: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., 'role-edit-button', 'role-status-switch', 'create-role-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Roles List screen according to the redesign requirements in the problem statement.
Implement the table using Shadcn UI table components, customized for a 'cardless, rectangular, dense' look. Avoid wrapping the table in a thick, rounded card.
Create a custom 'PermissionCoverageBar' component to visualize the module count vs total modules across the 8 categories. This is the visual centerpiece of the row.
Differentiate 'System Protected' roles clearly with a lock icon and disabled edit actions (replace Edit pencil with View eye).
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Do not use generic fonts like Inter for headings.
Incorporate the brand's green (#22c55e) and orange accents purposefully, avoiding gradient overload.
Ensure all mock data matches the structure described in the problem statement (e.g., 8 business-function groups, system_role flags).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, on-distribution outputs (the 'AI slop' aesthetic).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Always specify properties.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
